apps.name: Calculator
apps.limitations: Tests GTK startup and captures arithmetic. The test does not check other app functions.

apps.name: KCalc
apps.limitations: Tests Qt startup and captures arithmetic. The test does not check other app functions.

apps.name: VSCodium
apps.limitations: Tests Electron startup and captures the editor. The recipe depends on getting-started text that may change. It does not test extensions or accounts.

apps.name: VLC
apps.limitations: Opens and captures a short silent CC0 test video in a clean profile. This checks that VLC opens a media file and presents video, but does not prove audio output, codec support beyond this fixture, hardware acceleration, or general playback compatibility. It uses no account or audio-device assertions.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.limitations: Opens a bundled CC0 sample document in Writer and captures it. Does not test editing, saving, exporting, or compatibility with other file formats.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.limitations: Startup-only check in a clean profile. The hosted capture shows Firefox's first-run welcome dialog, not a loaded web page. No screenshot recipe. Does not test page rendering, network access, accounts, extensions, media playback, or general web compatibility.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.limitations: Startup visibility can pass on the splash screen. The separate recipe selects the empty editor by its English window title and waits for Tools and Filters menus before capture, with the welcome dialog disabled in a fresh profile. Does not test image loading, editing, saving, exporting, plug-in functionality, color management, or format compatibility.
